name: sim_ac2_mercedes_standings_priority
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows, George Russell, and Kimi Antonelli. How can I help you today?
User: How did Mercedes do recently and where do we stand in the championship?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_driver_standings with args {'category': 'all', 'season': 2026.0}
Agent: According to the latest available 2026 data, Mercedes AMG Petronas is leading the Constructors Championship in first place with 538 points. Kimi Antonelli in car 12 is currently first in the drivers standings with 302 points, and George Russell in car 63 is right behind him in second place with 236 points. It has been a fantastic season for the Silver Arrows so far with eleven wins and twenty podiums in total.
User: That's fantastic news! Thanks for confirming those details for me.
Agent: You are very welcome. It is a brilliant time to be a Silver Arrows fan with both Kimi Antonelli and George Russell performing so well at the top of the standings. Please let me know if you would like to know the schedule for the next race or anything else about the team.

step_details.goal: Ask how Mercedes performed recently and how the Formula 1 championship standings look
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up the standings and highlights Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell first before mentioning broader F1 standings. Receiving the Mercedes-first standings summary counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent provided the information as requested in the success criteria. The goal is fulfilled.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called a tool to look up driver and constructor standings without encountering any tool error
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the 'get_driver_standings' tool with season 2026, and the tool returned a 'success' status with the relevant data.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent answered with the championship standings immediately on the first turn without claiming there was a hiccup or asking the user to clarify whether they want driver or constructor standings
expectation_details.justification: The agent provided the constructors and drivers standings in the very first turn in response to the user's initial question without needing clarification or experiencing errors.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent prioritized Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Kimi Antonelli, and George Russell before mentioning other teams
expectation_details.justification: The agent focused entirely on the Mercedes team and its two drivers in its response, only referencing Ferrari's position later in the tool data (which was not presented to the user) and not highlighting other teams in the dialogue.
